name: reporting-studio
description: Build presentations, briefings, and portable sites from verified sources.

com.github.xubaodian.agent-cook.instructions: Use a shared set of verified facts and metrics when the brief spans multiple formats. Shape the report around the audience and verify each delivered format. When delegating to browser-reviewer, include the static-site Skill's entry from the catalog. For out/site/index.html, run a passing Playwright text assertion and capture a current PNG under out/site/ before submission.
